Cursed Item, Grade 3 (Requires Attunement)

This smooth, oval stone is etched with faintly glowing, magical symbols. A creature can make a DC 15 Intelligence (History) check to determine that these runes are reminiscent of the norse shamans. While attuned to the item, at the start of a long rest you can store cursed energy within the battery up to your proficiency bonus + your Cursed Energy modifier and the battery is considered full. This cursed energy cannot be regained until you finish a long rest. While holding the battery, you can take an action to touch the battery to immediately regain the stored cursed energy.
